complex_convention: Larch complex path reconstructed as -chi_imag + 1j*chi. Full shell is the complex sum with native degeneracies; sigma2=0 avoids damping high-k differences.
interpretation: Separate one-factor variations. Lower-radius probes are sensitivity bounds; larger-radius comparisons test local numerical stability only, not global convergence.
phase_mask: Keep points where baseline |complex path| >= 5% of its maximum in the window; use circular phase differences weighted by squared k^2 baseline amplitude.
threshold_reason: Predeclared numerical review triggers, not literature standards or experimental uncertainty. 5% complex / 3% amplitude changes flag material numerical dependence. A 0.03 rad phase change would correspond roughly to 0.0025 A at k=6 if entirely represented as 2k*dR; this is not a fit bias estimate.
